worlds.source: Original K4R EmptyEnv(size8) and FourRoomsEnv, FullyObsWrapper PUBLIC image; no env.unwrapped, hidden grid, native state outside own source, task-family or seed in learner features.

training.experience: Record fully public before state, action 0,1,2 from independently seeded uniform exploration, after state, original environment reward, terminated/truncated; every native method and Q/Dynamics sees identical FIT transitions and order. No heldout state before all models/checkpoints frozen.
training.public_current: position x/y, facing direction, goal position and public front_blocked, derived from FullyObsWrapper image only. Original K4T native interfaces see exactly these fields.
training.wingless: Real native Go package imported as source-authenticated Go code, persistent JSON-lines bridge; learn from exact FIT public transitions; cold restart binary in fresh process from authenticated snapshot.
training.yggdrasil: Real native Python source module loaded by explicit hash path; learn from exact FIT public transitions; independent Python cold restore of saved authenticated checkpoint.
training.conventional: K4R original empirical forward dynamics + BFS, original public BFS expert upper bound, same-FIT tabular Q, seeded random 0/1/2 and fixed forward. No new conventional training advantage given.
training.models_frozen: Native policy snapshots, conventional state digests and public policy predictions frozen after FIT. CHECK is a diagnostic, not a tuning set. DEV is once-only original first-use development evidence.

evaluation.checkpoint_test: Native learn FIT, serialize SHA version, terminate transport, reopen new independent native OS process and check identical decisions on 8 original FIT public observations; Yggdrasil cold Python subprocess; enforce invalid-action and tamper guards from own native source qualification.
evaluation.CHECK: 4 fresh public worlds per family per candidate and controls, store actual real reward and state/action trace hashes. No candidate retuning after CHECK. CHECK cannot advance science.
evaluation.DEV: 8 fresh public worlds per family per method, each method starts an independent identically seeded fresh environment and has 96 or192 legal decisions maximum. No learning from CHECK or DEV consequences; policy learning has only FIT evidence. Compare real success and return.
evaluation.qualify: Each native candidate separately must succeed on >=5/8 unfamiliar DEV worlds in EACH Empty and FourRooms, improve at least 2/8 wins above tabular Q in FourRooms, have >=2 distinct chosen first actions across DEV, preserve exact native predictions after cold restarts, and have mean returns within 0.75 of learned dynamics planner on EACH family. Both candidates must individually pass before claiming native family source advancement. Otherwise NO_GO even if benchmark conventional methods succeed.
evaluation.resource: Record per-method FIT update CPU, native checkpoint sizes, inference CPU separately from shared FIT physics, whole run wall/CPU/max RSS; never present raw Go bridge IPC overhead as native computational FLOPs or full per-method power. Give no efficiency advantage if baselines equally good at less full measured cost.
evaluation.scientific_limit: Even if both succeed, results are PUBLIC DEVELOPMENT, not accepted protected FSA scientific first use, new architecture discovery or general transfer; separate independent-source preregistration and scientific admission mandatory.
